title: The reading says my cash is over
text: Cash is over when you count more money than the reading expects. This usually means some cash was added without recording it.
steps: Check the opening float. Make sure it was recorded as Cash In.
Check that cash sales were not recorded as card, e-wallet, or credit.
Count only the drawer. Do not include petty cash or an old float.
Count the cash again by denomination. Compare it with Cash In Drawer on the slip and write down the reason.
keywords: why is my z read over

title: The reading says my cash is short
text: Cash is short when you count less money than the reading expects. This usually means cash left the drawer or too much change was given.
steps: Check that all payouts, supplier payments, and petty cash were recorded as Cash Out under More Options > Cash-in/Cash-out.
Check that all cash refunds were recorded.
Check recent sales for an incorrect tendered amount or too much change.
If cash was removed after you counted, count the drawer again before generating the reading.

title: How the reading works out the expected cash
text: Expected Cash In Drawer = cash sales + Cash In - Cash Out. Over or short is the difference between your count and this amount.
steps: Count cash sales only. Card, e-wallet, credit, and cheque payments are not included.
Voided sales and cash refunds are removed from the cash sales total.
Cash In and Cash Out are recorded under More Options > Cash-in/Cash-out on this register.
Cash already included in an earlier End of Day (Z) is not counted again.

title: The Y reading or cashier accountability will not print
text: The reading is saved even when it does not print. Printing works only in the TinkerPRO desktop or tablet app.
steps: In a web browser, click Download PDF when the reading is saved but does not print.
On a register, click Retry Print. Make sure the printer is on, has paper, and is connected.
Click More Options > Printer Setup. Make sure the paper width matches: 58mm and 80mm are different.
If it still does not print, open More Options > Cashier Report > History and print the reading again.

title: It says a reading already covers this window
text: A Y or Z reading already exists for this time period on this register. You cannot create another one for the same period.
steps: Check the message for the reading number and time period.
Open More Options > Cashier Report > History and print the existing reading.
To create a new reading, set From to the end of the last reading, then generate it.
Only a provider account can change or redo a saved reading. Contact support if it is incorrect.

title: It says another reading is being generated
text: Another reading is being created on this register. Wait until it finishes before creating a new one.
steps: Wait a few seconds, then click Generate again.
Make sure nobody else is closing this register.
Check the History tab. If the reading is listed, print it instead of creating another one.
If the message keeps appearing, close and reopen the Cashier Report window.

title: I cannot take an X, Y, or Z reading
text: X, Y, and Z readings have separate permissions. A cashier may have access to some readings but not others.
steps: Click Sidebar > Users & Security. Open the staff member's Permissions tab.
Turn on X-Reading, Y-Reading, or Z-Reading as needed, then click Save.
Ask the staff member to sign out and sign in again.
A supervisor can approve the reading when the approval box appears.
To show readings from all cashiers and terminals, turn on View All Readings.

title: The reading totals look wrong or too low
text: A reading shows sales for one register and time period. Check these settings if the total looks wrong.
steps: Check the From and To dates. Earlier sales are on an earlier reading.
Check that you selected the correct register. Each register has its own reading.
For an X reading, turn on General to include all sales. Turn it off to see only your sales.
Open More Options > Terminal Receipts and clear any sale still waiting to sync.

title: The Z reading did not ask me to count the drawer
text: Y always asks for a cash count. Z asks only when this setting is on. X never asks because it does not close anything.
steps: Click Settings > Cashier Settings.
In Cash & Shift, turn on Z Reading Requires Cash Count.
Click Save, then run the Z reading again. Count the cash by denomination when asked.
Without a count, the slip shows only the expected Cash In Drawer, not an over or short amount.

title: The cash out after my Y reading did not happen
text: Force Cash Out removes the counted cash automatically when you close a Y reading. If it fails, record the cash out manually.
steps: If cash out failed, open More Options > Cash-in/Cash-out.
Click Remove Cash, enter the amount you counted, and add a clear reason.
If automatic cash out never works, go to Settings > Cashier Settings and check Force Cash Out under Cash & Shift.
At the next shift, record the starting cash as Cash In.
keywords: cash out could not be recorded

title: Finding and reprinting a past reading
text: Past readings stay on record. You can print them again or export them.
steps: Click Point of Sale > More Options > Cashier Report > History.
Select the reading you want. Cashiers see their own readings unless View All Readings is on.
For readings from several days, click Reporting > Cash Management > Z Reading.
Print or export the reading. Reprinting does not change the figures.
